· 5-day / 20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low) + Confirmed support at the low, potential for recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.05x) + Normal confidence level for price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + Conditions for entry: RSI recovery above 50 and MACD golden cross confirmation.
